title: How do I change colour shade/ habit strength?
body: How do I change the shade/ strength of the colour for a habit? There’s a count scale from 0-10 but it doesn’t seem to affect the shade of the colour. Say my habit was to do cardio and I want to rate it as 5/10 effort and for the colour to appear somewhat muted to reflect that - how do I do this? Thanks in advance for the help!
author: User2357a
